steps.content: Carcasses of Corruptors pile high all around. In their midst stands a figure in a white dress tainted with filth. How did a feeble-looking scholar like her survive such a battle? What kind of power does she possess? Where did she acquire her power?
It's obvious that she is growing weaker, but not just from the effort of defeating the Corruptors.

steps.speaker: Apparition
steps.content: Hu...hu... hah...Hahah... This doesn't make any sense...

steps.speaker: Apparition
steps.content: It's not a celestial body or a meteorite... It's not made of organic matter... or inorganic matter...

steps.speaker: Apparition
steps.content: Mass-energy equivalence doesn't apply, the speed doesn't make sense, everything is topsy-turvy. Bring in extra dimensions to explain all this? Could it be consciousness distortion? No, it can't be. There must have been a miscalculation. Start over...

steps.speaker: Apparition
steps.content: Theories, hypotheses... Doesn't matter from which field... I need more tools to tackle it. I must have miscalculated, I must have failed to include some important factors. We have done so much work on this, we can, we will unveil its secrets.

steps.speaker: Apparition
steps.content: Who's there?!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You were led astray again. It's dangerous here. Let's go back.

steps.speaker: Apparition
steps.content: Back? Back to where? You want me to leave the Forbidden Sea?

steps.speaker: Apparition
steps.content: You want me to go back too? First the captain, now you. You think I can't protect myself?

steps.speaker: Apparition
steps.content: Or is this your roundabout way of saying I'm no longer needed as an astronomer, because you think that's not a real "meteorite"?

options: It's because it's dangerous here and you're being affected by Mania!

steps.speaker: Apparition
steps.content: I am not scared of danger! Don't you underestimate science!

steps.speaker: Apparition
steps.content: I am a scholar. The ultimate truth is right around the corner. It is calling me, the Perishing Star. It is very close.

steps.speaker: Apparition
steps.content: It laughs at the futility of our efforts. Well, laugh away. I'm not leaving until I've found the answer.

steps.speaker: Apparition
steps.content: One theory is disproved, the next comes along. Step by step, we will solve the ultimate equation. Anything that can be known will be known. We will find the ultimate truth.

steps.speaker: Apparition
steps.content: <size=29>I don't fear death. And even if the existence of the Perishing Star disapproves everything we know about the laws of science and shows us how ignorant we are, well... We're no strangers to that! We've done this many times over. Science progresses on the ruins of old. Now, it's my turn to build new theories.</size>
Maniac contamination is encroaching on her body, but her eyes are burning with sheer determination.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Take a minute to collect yourself. Your expedition has not ended yet. If you die here or go insane, everything you've worked so hard for will go to waste.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You're a scientist. You should keep a clear head. Please come with me. You don't want to get lost, if you still want to capture that meteorite.

steps.speaker: Apparition
steps.content: ... Decided to continue?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Go and seek the ultimate truth. You have the Guide here to help you, and I will always point you the path.
The look she gives you is gentle, but still tinged with uncertainty and confusion. She forgets who you are again.

steps.speaker: Apparition
steps.content: Sorry... who are you again? I can't remember your name...
You pause for a second. And then a name comes to your foggy mind.
${PlayerName}.
You take her hand.
The shackles run through the apparition, as if through air. You hear a voice before you leave her.

steps.speaker: Vague Voice
steps.content: It's too late... too late...
